_comment: Per-type backfill TODO for the SDK Provider property-coverage test
`types` lists CFn schema properties NOT yet covered by the provider's
handledProperties or unhandledByDesign for that type. Auto-generated:
1. If the provider's create()/update() ALREADY wires the property
to the SDK call, add it to handledProperties.get(type).
2. If the provider intentionally does NOT wire it (create-only,
deprecated, covered by a separate resource, etc.), add it to
3. Remove the entry from this file.
`bogusTolerated` lists properties the provider DECLARES in
handledProperties (or unhandledByDesign) but that the CFn schema does
NOT have. Typically SDK-only request fields (e.g. ClientToken) or
stale aliases the provider author predated the schema rename. Each
entry MUST carry a one-line rationale; the section is preserved across

AWS::AutoScaling::AutoScalingGroup.DefaultCooldown: SDK input field name; CFn schema names the same field 'Cooldown'. Provider currently maps the SDK name through handledProperties; investigate whether to rename or split the safety-net check (follow-up of #391).

AWS::BedrockAgentCore::Runtime.ClientToken: SDK-only idempotency token; never appears on a CFn template. Listing it in handledProperties was defensive but unnecessary — leave tolerated until a separate cleanup PR.

AWS::DynamoDB::GlobalTable.TableClass: CFn schema exposes this only nested under Replicas[].TableClass; provider's top-level handledProperties entry predates the schema layout. Investigate per-replica drift handling separately.
AWS::DynamoDB::GlobalTable.DeletionProtectionEnabled: Same shape as TableClass — CFn nests this under Replicas[]; provider declares it at top level. Follow-up cleanup.

AWS::ElastiCache::SubnetGroup.CacheSubnetGroupDescription: SDK input field name; CFn schema names the same field 'Description'. Investigate whether to rename in a follow-up.

AWS::Glue::Crawler.LineageConfiguration: Provider's createCrawler/updateCrawler wires this field via the SDK (glue-provider.ts:2277, 2386); the property is live in AWS but cloudformation:DescribeType (CFn registry schema) does NOT surface it. Likely a registry-schema-vs-user-guide-doc lag on AWS's side. Tolerated until AWS publishes it in the registry.

AWS::Glue::Job.SourceControlDetails: Schema snapshot (2026-05) does not include this property. Verify in a follow-up.

AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy.Tags: CFn user-guide doc + AWS SDK (CreatePolicyCommand) accept Tags, but cloudformation:DescribeType (CFn registry schema) does NOT surface it for AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy as of the 2026-05 snapshot. Provider wires Tags through CreatePolicy / Tag / Untag — registry schema lag, not a real bug.

AWS::Neptune::DBInstance.DeletionProtection: CFn schema has DeletionProtection only on DBCluster, not DBInstance. Likely a copy-paste from the cluster handler — verify before removing.

AWS::S3Tables::Table.Name: Likely typo for 'TableName' (CFn schema name). Real bug — fix in a follow-up PR.
AWS::S3Tables::Table.Format: Likely typo for 'OpenTableFormat' (CFn schema name). Real bug — fix in a follow-up PR.

AWS::Route53::RecordSet.GeoProximityLocation: AWS removed this from the CFn schema, but `@aws-sdk/client-route-53` still declares it as a member of ResourceRecordSet, and the provider wires it at src/provisioning/providers/route53-provider.ts:1535. cdkd calls the SDK directly, so the value still reaches AWS; deleting the declaration would only make the coverage checker under-report a property cdkd sends. Written automatically by the schema refresh job.
